verdict.rationale: Online account integration for calendar, contacts and data is a fair capability for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an online-accounts feature or any sync of calendars or contacts. Community mentions of default apps such as Thunderbird are adjacent at most and do not show built-in online account integration.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can bring my online calendar, contacts, and data into the desktop with online account integration
